response.sql:
WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(sa.mean_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage,
       AVG(sa.mean_usage - oa.mean_usage) AS average_above_overall
FROM station_averages AS sa
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE sa.mean_usage > oa.mean_usage;

assumptions.assumption: “Above average” compares each station’s average telescope usage with the average usage across all telescopes; both requested figures are unweighted averages across the qualifying stations.
